_comment: Mutation testing for the security-critical crypto modules. Validates that the tests would CATCH a bug, not just execute the line. Runs in CI (.github/workflows/mutation.yml) only when these modules or their tests change. `break` is a RATCHET FLOOR, not the target: the current overall score is ~75% (crypto.ts ~83%, decrypt-cipher.ts ~91%, vault-decrypt.ts ~57% — the remaining drag), so break is set just below that to block regressions while the suite's assertions are strengthened. Raise `break` toward `low`/`high` as survivors are killed — same discipline as the coverage ratchet; vault-decrypt.ts per-field assertions are the next tranche. Run locally: npm run mutation:crypto (see reports/mutation/crypto.html).
